dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge with a pronounced falcate curve from the dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Narrowly rounded apex with a small pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Convex anterior margin with a steepness of approximately 50 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum pixel base width to vertical height ratio of approximately 0.85:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Gently sloping convex melon forming a continuous large-radius arc toward the rostrum.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust rostrum with a low length-to-thickness ratio protruding from the cranial base.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Highly obtuse angle of approximately 160 degrees at the transition point between the melon and rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct white depigmented notch or scar located on the mid-trailing edge of the dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent tri-color hourglass pigmentation pattern on the lateral flank, characterized by a dark dorsal cape and lighter thoracic and caudal patches.
